event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Semis cracked, defensives bid.
Higher-for-longer repricing plus Oct ISM Manufacturing 54.6 vs 54.5 fc and Q3 ECI 0.8% vs 0.80 fc kept the long end bid (IEF +0.56%) while SOXX -8.24% and INTC -28.58% did the damage; QQQ fell 2.3x normal volume, so this was semiconductor distribution, not a broad-market unwind. Money rotated into XLE +1.91% and XLP +1.41% rather than to cash, and Polymarket now prices a December hike at 70% YES.

INDICES — VIX 19.4, above its 17.0 20-day MA.
SOXX -8.24%, QQQ -3.47%, SPY -1.77%, IWM -1.65%, DIA -1.07%. Small beat large by 0.56pp (IJR -1.21% vs SPY -1.77%), so the damage was mega-cap tech, not size. Cross-asset tell: VIXY +10.50% while TLT +0.43% and the dollar (UUP) -0.14% — a pure equity-vol shock, not a rates or FX one.

VOLUME & BREADTH — QQQ traded 2.3x average and SOXX 2.1x on down days: distribution in the leaders.
SPY volume was not elevated on the same scale (IJH 1.1x, IWM 1.0x, IJR 0.9x show small caps ignored). XLK 2.2x and XLP 2.0x both gained volume — tech selling, staples accumulation. Breadth diverges from the tape's headline: only 45% of S&P names rose, %>50DMA 60, up/down vol ratio 0.48 with 62 new highs vs 40 lows — participation is mixed, not a narrow mega-cap tape.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy +1.91%, XLP Staples +1.41%, XLU Utilities +0.67%, XLV Healthcare +0.45%, XLRE Real Estate +0.26%, XLC Comms +0.00%, XLB Materials +0.00%, XLY Discretionary -0.71%, XLF Financials -0.76%, XLI Industrials -1.60%, XLK Technology -4.89%.
Industries: XOP +2.13% and FCG +1.81% led; SOXX -8.24% and DRAM -7.23% lagged. Flows contradict the leaders: XLF +781mm (86p) and XLI +586mm (88p) took the biggest 5-day inflows while XLK +427mm (85p) was bought into the drop, and XLU -773mm (0p) and XLE -82mm (35p) bled. Money is moving out of defensives and into cyclicals/financials — the opposite of today's price. Rotation state: 'AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation'.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.98 and skew +11.8% show real downside hedging; QQQ PCR 0.70 is the complacent read.
VIX 19.4 vs 17.0 MA and VVIX 106.4 vs 95.5 confirm fear building, while VIXEQ 42.3 vs VIX 19.4 is a wide gap — high single-stock dispersion, not correlation. IWM PCR 1.49 and SLV PCR 0.42 are the extremes: small-cap protection demand, silver crowded long.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold -3.47% and silver -5.67% fell despite a risk-off tape and a weaker dollar — liquidation of crowded precious-metal longs, not a fear bid.
Oil held (USO +0.38%, 20d +14.56%) into a semi crash, the one asset ignoring the equity move. Next FOMC is Dec 9: CME FedWatch shows hike 100.0% (hold/cut 0.0%), while Polymarket prices 70% YES on a December 25bp hike, down 9pp in 5 days.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 55.3, Neutral.
Top movers: INTC -28.58% (headline ties Broadcom's $63bn AI-chip financing), QCOM -11.12%, AMD -10.88%. Vol spikes: INTC 4.6x and AEM 3.0x -5.99% — both distribution (vol up, price down). Momentum: XLE +11.46% and XLP +11.04% over 20d lead; XLK -10.16% and SOXX -19.93% are the worst. Watch: IBIT -5.14% at 3.4x volume, QQQE -2.45% at 3.0x (equal-weight techi breadth break), and QQQ -3.47% into its -7.88% 20d trend.
